note: Round lm50 (Tokyo). Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south (three.js local axes before rotation). buildings / parts / roads / terrain = the app's own staged map data (site/tyodata, v37 build from the OSM Kantō extract of Oct 2026): exactly what the page draws; osm / name / ja / floors / h_osm = the current OSM building matched to the app record (iou = overlap of the two outlines; "-" = no OSM match). h = the app height (OSM / PLATEAU value or an estimate: est = true when OSM has neither height nor levels) - often wrong for towers: use meta.h / your research. parts: building:part pieces (base / top); a building with parts whose outline the app does not draw (a part starts at the ground) has type "parts only". roads: cls (0-1 freeway, 2-9 arterials, 10 local, 11 service, 12 path, 13 runway, 14 taxiway, 15 rail, 16 monorail, 17 pier); br = bridge; bridges / flyovers are kept whole with elev = the app's deck height above the ground per vertex. areas = OSM land-use / leisure / amenity / tourism / historic / man_made / water polygons clipped to the box. pois: src app (the page's labels) or osm (named nodes). radius = max(1.6 r, r + 60), capped at 700 m. ground = terrain height (m) at the anchor; terrain = grid rows north to south.
